title: Aangan Architecture JSON
description: Version 1: a plot and its rectangular rooms. All coordinates and dimensions are in feet. The origin is the plot's southwest corner; x increases east and y increases north.

width_ft.description: East-west plot size, measured along the x axis.

depth_ft.description: South-north plot size, measured along the y axis.

facing.description: Cardinal side of the plot fronting the road.

level.description: 0 is the ground floor; positive integers are floors above it.

id.description: Globally unique room identifier, such as living_01.

type.description: Room category in snake_case, such as living or master_bedroom.

x.description: West edge of the room, measured east from the plot's west edge.

y.description: South edge of the room, measured north from the plot's south edge.

width.description: East-west size of the room in feet.

depth.description: South-north size of the room in feet.
